opening.argument: The presentation is an instructional walkthrough of the Office 365 Admin Center and its ordinary administrative functions. It explains that administrators can manage “people, software and cloud services in one central place,” search for settings, update information, and manage passwords, licenses, and group membership. The visible migration page further demonstrates operational guidance for moving data from services such as Gmail, Outlook, and Hotmail, while the security and compliance page presents auditing, protection, rules, and DLP controls. References to subscriptions, licenses, payments, and billing remain within this product-administration framework: “Purchase subscriptions, add licenses, and update payments.” Nothing presented solicits money, credentials, or participation; the material explains how to operate and configure an enterprise service.

citations.quote: With the Office 365 Admin Centre, you can manage your people, software and cloud services in one central place.
Under users you add, remove, or update the people in your organization including their passwords, licenses, and group membership.
Purchase subscriptions, add licenses, and update payments, Or, sign up to a public website through a Microsoft partner.
